name: Underway Core
description: The settings and the paintings page for the Underway widgets (underway_photo, underway_plate, underway_fleet, underway_scene): the aisstream.io key, the fal.ai key, the daily painting budget and the contact for Wikimedia Commons. No widget of its own.

settings.name: aisstream_key
settings.label: aisstream.io API key
settings.help: Free at https://aisstream.io: sign in with GitHub and make a key. The widget keeps one stream open for the sea round each place while a page asks (aisstream allows three per key) and lets it go after twenty minutes without one. Not needed with a receiver of your own.

settings.name: fal_api_key
settings.label: fal.ai API key (AI paintings)
settings.help: With a key the widgets can paint each vessel from her photograph, at about US$0.04 a painting, once per ship and style. Leave it blank to use the key under Settings › Generative AI. Without either the widgets show photographs.

settings.name: contact
settings.label: Contact for Wikimedia Commons
settings.help: An email address or a web page, sent in the widget's User-Agent as Wikimedia asks of every application that reads its API. The widget names its own project page by default.

settings.name: gen_daily_usd
settings.label: Painting budget per day
settings.help: The most the widgets may spend on new paintings in a day, at the models' listed prices (US$4 is about a hundred Nano Banana paintings). 0 is no limit, within the ceiling under Settings › Generative AI. Paintings are kept, so a ship in a style only costs once.

settings.name: gen_per_refresh
settings.label: New paintings started per preview
settings.help: How many new paintings one settled preview in the editor may start (1 to 50). A panel's own render starts what its page needs, within the daily budget.

settings.name: gen_parallel
settings.label: Paintings made at once
settings.help: How many paintings fal.ai works on side by side (1 to 8).
